app.description: Path to the module whose default export is createApp(ctx), relative to the project root (the directory that holds oodlc/). Without it the project only explains a system: intents and the inventory, discovered from evidence. See docs/decisions/0011

catalog.description: Directory of catalog YAML files. Default: oodlc/ itself. Only the legacy oodle.yaml layout needs it

given.description: Baseline state, stubs and body merged under every run

conditions.description: Extra conditions to probe every unknown route under, e.g. [security.no-credentials, security.injection]. Every constraint is checked on each probe

database.description: A real database for the app, simulated in process: Postgres with PGlite (npm i -D @electric-sql/pglite), which the app reaches through DATABASE_URL with its own driver, or SQLite (engine: sqlite), which a Worker reaches as D1; every run starts from the schema plus given.db, and each row the app writes is recorded as an internal effect (db.<table>.inserted, .updated, .deleted). See docs/decisions/0009

engine.description: postgres (the default) runs PGlite and serves DATABASE_URL. sqlite runs SQLite in process with node:sqlite (Node 22.13 or later, nothing to install), which a Cloudflare Worker sees as its D1 binding. See docs/decisions/0017

schema.description: SQL applied once before the runs: a .sql file, or a folder whose .sql files are applied in name order (prisma/migrations, drizzle, supabase/migrations, db/migrations). Down migrations are skipped. Relative to the project root

env.description: Environment variables set to the simulated database's URL before the app loads. Default DATABASE_URL

proposed.description: Proposals Oodle drafted from traffic. No run reads them: accept a stub by moving it into defaults.given.stubs, without its evidence. See docs/decisions/0015

sealed.description: The simulation is sealed by default: real network access from the app violates the built-in oodle.sealed constraint and blocks. false opens it; { allow: [host, host:port] } lets named hosts through. See docs/decisions/0005
